failure.storage_failed: The sign-in could not be saved to Windows Credential Manager.

extensions.secretHint: Secret values are written only to Windows Credential Manager. Leave an existing value blank to keep it.

hosted.disconnect_description: Uploads the changes only this PC has, then disconnects. Local projects and cloud copies are retained.
hosted.disconnect_uploading: Uploading the changes only this PC has: {{count}} left. Disconnecting now leaves the rest on this PC only.
hosted.disconnect_unuploaded: {{count}} changes have not been uploaded. After disconnecting they stay on this PC only.

connect_errors.local_project_sync_conflict: A project on this PC and the same project in the cloud are two different sync records (the library folder was copied, or restored from a backup on another PC). So that neither side is overwritten, sync was not connected. You can keep writing locally.
connect_errors.local_project_sync_conflict_named: {{projects}} on this PC and in the cloud are two different sync records (the library folder was copied, or restored from a backup on another PC). So that neither side is overwritten, sync was not connected. You can keep writing locally.

models.credentialsDesc: Keys are written only to this device's system keychain; they never sync to other devices or pass through Drifting. Pick the provider and model the Agent uses from the configuration menu in its composer.
models.speechDesc: The transcription credential for voice input, separate from the chat providers above. Transcription carries this project's element and setting names to correct proper nouns; requests go directly from this device to Bailian and the key lives only in the system keychain.

onboarding.saveFailed: Could not save the key to Windows Credential Manager.

signOut.pending: Changes on this PC the cloud doesn't have yet: {{count}}. If you sign out now, they stay on this PC and upload when you sign back in to this account.
signOut.pendingLocal: Changes on this PC the cloud doesn't have yet: {{count}}. If you sign out now, they stay on this PC only.

sync.accountMismatch: A library connects to one Drifting account, and the library on this PC already belongs to another, so it was not connected to this one. To switch, disconnect sync under Account (no need to sign in to the original account), then sign in with this account. Your local projects and their cloud copies are kept.
